{{Quote|Valarian, a female Whiphid, became Jabba the Hutt's main rival on Tatooine. Her partner, J'Quille, was sent to spy in Jabba's palace with the goal of poisoning the crime lord's food. While he was there he witnessed the arrival and capture of Leia Organa, who had come to rescue Han Solo.|An entry in an artist's journal restored and expanded by the Graf Archive|<ref name="Alien Archives">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref>}}
'''J'Quille''' was a [[Whiphid]] [[Gender|male]] from the [[planet]] [[Toola]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War]], he worked as a [[bounty hunter]] for the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] on the planet [[Tatooine]]. Unbeknownst to Jabba, the Whiphid truly served as a [[spy]] for the Hutt's rival [[Lady]] [[Valarian]], with whom J'Quille had a romantic affair, and planned to [[Death|kill]] Jabba for her by [[poison]]ing the Hutt's [[Foodstuff|food]]. J'Quille was present in [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] in the [[Standard year|year]] [[4 ABY]], when a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebels]] attempted to [[Rescue of Han Solo|rescue]] the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] from Jabba's clutches. The Whiphid witnessed the arrival and capture of each member of the group.

After the final rebel, the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]], was captured, J'Quille traveled on the Hutt's [[sail barge]], the ''[[Khetanna]]'', to witness the rebels' planned executions at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon|Pit of Carkoon]]. However, the rebels managed to defeat Jabba's forces there and kill the Hutt, destroying his sail barge as they escaped. J'Quille survived the explosion but found that Valarian had placed a [[bounty]] on him, since he had not been personally responsible for Jabba's death. Unable to leave Tatooine, J'Quille joined the [[B'omarr Order]].

==Biography==
===A spy in the palace===
The [[Whiphid]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Force Collection J'Quille" /> J'Quille was [[Reproduction|born]] on the frozen [[Planet|world]] of [[Toola]], but he dwelt on the [[desert]] planet [[Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]]. On Tatooine, he served in the [[Valarian's gang|gang]] of the [[crime lord]] [[Lady]] [[Valarian]], a fellow Whiphid with whom he had a romantic affair.<ref name="CEUE" />

Acting as a [[spy]] for Valarian, J'Quille took up work as a [[bounty hunter]] in the [[Jabba's criminal empire|criminal empire]] of the [[Hutt]] crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], Valarian's biggest rival on Tatooine. While living in [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]], the Whiphid planned to add a<ref name="CEUE" /> slow-acting<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> [[poison]] to the Hutt's [[Foodstuff|food]] in order to [[Death|kill]] him for his lover.<ref name="CEUE" />

===Throne room spectator===
{{Quote|Yiiip!|J'Quille cries out as Valance head butts him|<ref name="BH42">[[Bounty Hunters 42|''Bounty Hunters'' 42]]</ref>}}
[[File:VaderInJabbasPalace-2015DarthVader1.jpg|thumb|right|300px|J'Quille was dismissed from Jabba the Hutt's throne room during a visit from Darth Vader.]]
In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Galaxy's Edge Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the flashback events of [[Galaxy's Edge 2|''Galaxy's Edge'' 2]] to [[1 BBY]].</ref> J'Quille was among a crowd of spectators in the palace's [[throne]] room who witnessed the [[Rodian]] [[Greedo]] return from an unsuccessful [[Mission to Mygeeto|mission]] to the planet [[Mygeeto]]. Jabba was about to drop the Rodian into his [[rancor]] pit for his failure, when Greedo offered up the [[Ki-Adi-Mundi's lightsaber|lightsaber]] of [[Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi]] as tribute. The [[Ithorian]] [[Dok-Ondar]] immediately offered to buy the [[lightsaber]] from Jabba, causing the Hutt to show leniency to the Rodian.<ref name="GE2">[[Galaxy's Edge 2|''Galaxy's Edge'' 2]]</ref>

In the [[Standard year|year]] [[0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Darth Vader (2015) 1|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 1]] to [[0 ABY]].</ref> J'Quille was again present in the throne room when the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] paid Jabba a visit in order to request the services of Jabba's [[bounty]] hunters. During the negotiations, J'Quille and the other members of the crime lord's court were dismissed from the room in order to give the pair privacy.<ref name="V1">[[Darth Vader (2015) 1|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 1]]</ref>

At some point between [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]],<ref name="BH42Date">[[Han Solo]] is shown to be frozen in [[carbonite]] in [[Bounty Hunters 42|''Bounty Hunters'' 42]], meaning it must take place between when he was first [[Escape from Cloud City|frozen]] and when he was [[Rescue of Han Solo|thawed]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]] respectively.</ref> J'Quille was part of a crowd that witnessed the bounty hunter [[Beilert Valance]] fight his way into Jabba's throne room through a group of Gamorrean guards. The Hutt then informed those present that anyone who could bring him Valance alive would rise in his esteem and be paid fifty thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. J'Quille and several other members of the crowd moved forward to take on the bounty hunter, but Valance quickly incapacitated the bounty hunter [[Dengar]] and two other challengers before head butting the Whiphid and sending him tumbling back into the [[Gran]]<ref name="BH42" /> [[Ree-Yees]].<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> Valance then also defeated Ree-Yees before being subdued by the bounty hunter [[Boba Fett]].<ref name="BH42" />

===A message from a Jedi Knight===
[[File:Cheering_for_Oola.png|thumb|left|300px|J'Quille cheered with the other denizens of Jabba's Palace when the dancer Oola fell into the rancor pit.]]
J'Quille was again present in Jabba's Palace<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> in 4 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]],<ref name="SWGA">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY]].</ref> when the [[droid]]s [[C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2]] delivered a message to Jabba from self-proclaimed [[Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker]], who wished for the release of his captured friend—the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]], [[Carbon-freezing|frozen]] in [[carbonite]]. While the [[Hologram|holographic]] message was displayed, J'Quille sat in one of the throne room's booths<ref name="ROTJ" /> with the [[Yarkora]] [[Saelt-Marae]].<ref name="AEYNTK">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> J'Quille watched in awe<ref name="Topps">{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files|cardname=J'Quille Whiphid Bounty Hunter|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/170092/cid/11689267/2018-Topps-Star-Wars-Galactic-Files-ROTJ-29-J'Quille}}</ref> as the message ended with Skywalker gifting the two droids to Jabba, and the pair was taken away and put to work in the palace.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Having moved to a different booth within the throne room, J'Quille later sat behind<ref name="ROTJ" /> the [[Elom]] [[Tanus Spijek]]<ref name="Force Collection">{{ForceCollection|Tanus Spijek|star=1}}</ref> during a [[music]]al performance of the song "[[Jedi Rocks]]" put on for Jabba<ref name="ROTJ" /> by the [[Max Rebo Band]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> which ended when Jabba dropped one of the dancers,<ref name="ROTJ" /> a [[Twi'lek]] named [[Oola]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> into a pit before his throne that contained the [[Diet|carnivorous]] rancor<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Pateesa]].<ref name="LD">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref> J'Quille did not get up to view the dancer's demise but raised his arms and cheered along with the other members of the Hutt's court.<ref name="ROTJ" />

===The rebels arrive===
Moments later, the Whiphid was caught by surprise when [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], disguised<ref name="ROTJ" /> as the bounty hunter [[Boushh]],<ref name="CEUE" /> entered the throne room with the captured [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]], a companion of Solo's. Their arrival was part of a [[Rescue of Han Solo|plan to free Solo]] that also involved Skywalker's two droids as well as [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], a friend of Solo's who was working undercover as one of Jabba's guards. Standing directly in front of J'Quille, Organa claimed she had come to collect the bounty on Chewbacca's head but demanded that Jabba pay more than originally promised. After Organa threatened the room with a [[Class-A thermal detonator|thermal detonator]], the crime lord agreed to pay the higher bounty, and the Wookiee was taken away.<ref name="ROTJ" />

[[File:Stairway_at_Jabbas_palace.png|thumb|right|300px|J'Quille witnessed the capture of Leia Organa in Jabba's Palace.]]
Organa remained in the palace, believing that her disguise had worked; however,<ref name="ROTJ" /> the Hutt had been warned by Fett that Boushh was not what they seemed<ref name="POTDS">''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]''</ref> and, after pretending to leave the throne room later that [[Standard day|night]], remained in hiding along with much of his court. Believing the throne room to be clear, Organa snuck in and freed Solo from his carbon-freeze, after which Jabba and his court revealed their presence. J'Quille stood upon a set of stairs into the throne room and watched as both Solo and Organa were captured,<ref name="ROTJ" /> blocking their route to the exit.<ref name="Geektionary" /> The court then celebrated the capture late into the night.<ref name="POTDS" />

The next morning,<ref name="POTDS" /> when Skywalker himself arrived at Jabba's Palace to enact the final part of the rebel plan, J'Quille was once again in a booth in the throne room, [[sleep]]ing along with a number of other members of the court. The Whiphid awoke to see Skywalker attempt to negotiate with Jabba before threatening him with a [[DL-18 blaster pistol|blaster pistol]]. In response, the Hutt dropped the [[Jedi]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> and the [[Gamorrean]] guard [[Jubnuk]]<ref name="SWCL">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]''</ref> into the rancor pit. The court cheered for<ref name="ROTJ" /> Pateesa<ref name="LD" /> as they watched the fight in the pit play out, but Skywalker slew the beast, causing Jabba to order the execution of Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon|Pit of Carkoon]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

===Skirmish at the Pit of Carkoon===
[[File:Khetanna_boom.png|thumb|left|300px|J'Quille traveled to the Pit of Carkoon on Jabba's sail barge, which was later destroyed.]]
J'Quille and many other court members accompanied Jabba on his [[sail barge]],<ref name="CEUE" /> the ''[[Khetanna]]'',<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> to view the planned executions at the pit, where the rebels would be thrown into the jaws of a [[sarlacc]]. However, once at the pit, the rebel prisoners freed themselves and defeated Jabba's guards, while Organa, who had been chained to Jabba as a [[Slavery|slave]], strangled the Hutt. Skywalker then boarded the sail barge and rescued Organa, who pointed a [[Laser cannon|turret]] on the barge's top deck to shoot at the vehicle itself, causing it to explode as the rebels escaped.<ref name="ROTJ" />

J'Quille managed to survive the sail barge's explosion but later discovered that Valarian, his former lover, had placed a large bounty on his head, as he had not been the one to kill Jabba. Finding himself unable to leave Tatooine due to the bounty, the Whiphid chose to join the [[B'omarr Order]], a group of monks who lived within Jabba's Palace.<ref name="CEUE" /> J'Quille was mentioned in an [[Unidentified artist|artist's]] [[Unidentified artist's journal|journal]], which was restored, expanded, and displayed at the [[Graf Archive]]<ref name="Alien Archives" /> at some point no earlier than [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Year">{{AlienArchiveJournalDate}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
J'Quille was a brutal<ref name="CEUE" /> and fearsome-looking<ref name="Topps" /> member of the large Whiphid [[species]], with coarse, [[Color|gray]] [[Hair|fur]] and powerful tusks. He stood two [[meter]]s tall with pink skin and retractable, black-colored [[eye]]s.<ref name="CEUE" /> By the [[time]] that J'Quille encountered Luke Skywalker at Jabba's Palace, the Whiphid had fought and won many battles, which the Jedi could immediately tell despite never having met him before.<ref name="POTDS" />

==Skills and abilities==
J'Quille had above average strength and average fighting skills, speed, and intelligence. He had below average diplomatic skills and was not [[Force-sensitive]].<ref name="Topps" />

==Equipment==
J'Quille wore a [[belt]] with several pouches.<ref name="BH42" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Design and casting===
[[File:JQuilleMaquette.png|thumb|right|300px|A maquette of J'Quille was made for the film.]]
J'Quille first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> The character was designed by Creature Consultant [[Chris Walas]]<ref name="Databank">{{DB|species|whiphid|Whiphid}}</ref> and a maquette of the character measuring ten by two by eight [[centimeter]]s was made for the film.<ref name="Chronicle">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> [[Judy Elkins]] sculpted the costume itself.<ref name="Indiana">{{YouTube|video=kzWqHmjdZZ0|text=BTS - Return of the Jedi's Creatures | Full Panel #indianacomicconvention #starwarshistory #rotj|channel=@FanXComicConventions|name=FanX Comic Conventions|date=2025-03-29}}</ref> J'Quille was played by mime artist [[Tim Dry]],<ref name="Continuum">{{BookCite|author=Tim Dry|title=Continuum: The 'Star Wars' Phenomenon As Experienced From The Inside|contributor=|publisher=Bookbaby|date=2012}}</ref> who was uncredited.<ref name="ROTJ" /> At the time, Dry was one half of the mime duo [[Wikipedia:Tik and Tok|Tik and Tok]] with fellow mime artist [[Sean Crawford]], and neither had ever appeared in a film before. They were cast together after being invited by their former teacher Desmond Jones to a casting session with producer [[Robert Watts]], who was looking for around nine mime artists to fill creature roles in the upcoming ''[[Star Wars]]'' movie.<ref name="Continuum" />

Neither Dry nor Crawford knew who they would be portraying until they first visited [[Elstree Studios]], where most of their characters' scenes were filmed. Dry was assigned J'Quille, who was known only as "Tooth Face" during production,<ref name="Continuum" /> while Crawford was assigned the character Saelt-Marae,<ref name="Coolwaters">{{WebCite|url=https://www.coolwatersprods.com/Clients/seancrawford.html|text=Sean Crawford|work=[https://www.coolwatersprods.com/index.html Coolwaters Productions LLC]|archivedate=20170904180553}}</ref> known at the time as "Yak Face."<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|saeltmarae|Saelt-Marae}}</ref> Dry's contract stated that he would receive £300 per week for two weeks of guaranteed work on the film, and then £65 for any additional days after that.<ref name="Continuum" />

===On set===
[[File:JQuille-TotOR2023.png|thumb|left|300px|The J'Quille costume was worn by mime artist Tim Dry.]]
The J'Quille costume consisted of three layers: a white lycra body suit, a padded foam suit, and then a fur-covered shirt and pants on top, along with the costume head, which had eye slits in the nostrils for Dry to see out. The entire outfit was fairly heavy to wear and extremely warm inside, meaning that Dry had to remove the head in between takes so that he could be cooled down with hair dryers to prevent overheating. This was particularly an issue during the filming of the sail barge scenes, which were shot in the Arizona desert.<ref name="Continuum" />

The positions of J'Quille and each of the other extras in Jabba's Palace was chosen by first assistant director [[David Tomblin]], who placed Dry and Crawford seated together in one of the palace's booths for their first scene. While seated together, the two were unable to actually turn their heads and face each other while in costume. Between the takes of this scene, Dry and Crawford befriended Luke Skywalker actor [[Mark Hamill]], who was a similar age to them.<ref name="Continuum" />

===Naming and non-canon appearances===
In the current ''Star Wars'' [[canon]], J'Quille was first identified in the [[Star Wars video games|mobile card game]] ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'',<ref name="Force Collection" /> which initially launched in [[2013]]. Although the launch of ''Force Collection'' predates<ref name="Force Collection release">{{SW|url=news/announcing-star-wars-force-collection|text=Announcing Star Wars: Force Collection|nolive=1}}</ref> the ''Star Wars'' canon reset of [[2014]],<ref name="Legends">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref> [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Leland Chee]] confirmed that the game was kept updated to fit with canon.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|holocronkeeper|status/846807700482666496|[[Leland Chee]]|date=2017-03-28|quote=I'm not gonna go through the trouble of changing them and I don't have any reason to believe currently that anyone would. […] On the off-chance that we DID have a current need to change any of these, we would have for Force Collection.|archivedate=20210505080831}} — [[Leland Chee]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] has confirmed that [[in-universe]] information from ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' conforms with ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].</ref> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, "Tooth Face" first received the name [[J'Quille/Legends|J'Quille]] in the short story "[[Let Us Prey: The Whiphid's Tale]]," written by [[Marina Fitch]] and [[Mark Budz]], and included in the [[1995]] anthology book ''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]''.<ref name="TWT">{{StoryCite|story=Let Us Prey: The Whiphid's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>

J'Quille appeared in [[Jeffrey Brown]]'s [[2021]] non-canon children's book, ''[[A Vader Family Sithmas]]''. In the book he can be seen attending a holiday party at Jabba's Palace while wearing a pair of [[Wikipedia:Reindeer|reindeer antlers]] on a headband.<ref name="Sithmas">''[[A Vader Family Sithmas]]''</ref>
